claim_register.claim: The BIC tile permits `FMO_STA_CKR` and `FMO_STA_MKR` maintenance. Avoid leading and trailing spaces. Makers update records and delete `SAVE_CONFIRMED` records. Checkers approve or reject updates. Bulk delete applies to `SAVE_CONFIRMED` records. Bulk checker approval or rejection follows detail verification. `ADD_PENDING`, `UPDATE_PENDING`, and `DELETE_PENDING` record maker actions. `SAVE_CONFIRMED` makes approved additions or updates effective. Rejected updates preserve the original version. Approved deletion becomes `DELETE_CONFIRMED`, visible only in audit. Rejected additions become ineffective `DISCARDED` records.

claim_register.claim: The netting and Nostro static tile uses the same two profiles. Netting rule types distinguish manual and automatic netting. Maker-selected fields form AND conditions, with a reason. Automatic rules add netting date/time, resultant STP level, and netting type. Listed STP levels are `NSTP_MAKER_CHECKER` and `NSTP_CHECKER_ONLY`. New rules become effective after checker approval. Maker and checker must differ.

claim_register.claim: Creation refreshes matching cashflows with blank or null netting ID: WAITING Pending Netting/Pending Exception, or READY with null state type. It excludes WAITING Pending Another Leg/Pending Auto Netting, READY Pending Ack, HOLD, SUPPRESSED, NETTED, RELEASED, and SETTLED. Disabling refreshes only WAITING Pending Auto Netting cashflows tagged to that rule. Updating an automatic rule lists both tagged Pending Auto Netting cashflows and newly eligible matches. That update passage also excludes Pending Auto Netting, creating an unresolved contradiction. Manual-to-automatic changes use creation eligibility. Automatic-to-manual changes refresh tagged WAITING Pending Auto Netting cashflows. Preserve those operation-specific rules; do not broaden refresh to released or settled cashflows.
